description: Cryptographic integrity record for the authority manifest. The manifest is the root of trust — its own integrity must be verified at runtime. actual_manifest_hash != declared_manifest_hash → FAIL.
runtime_verification_rule: At runtime: compute SHA-256 of ARTIFACT_AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json. Compare to manifest_sha256 in this file. Mismatch → FAIL.
supersession_rule: Changes require AUTHORITY_MANIFEST_INTEGRITY_V2 with CEO approval
